description: A little figure whittled from scrap wood by firelight.  Someone made this for you.

variants.description: A little fox whittled from scrap wood by firelight, its tail curled around its feet.  Someone made this for you.
A little bird whittled from scrap wood by firelight, wings folded, head cocked as if listening.  Someone made this for you.
A stubby little bear whittled from scrap wood by firelight.  The knife slipped on one ear.  Someone made this for you.
A little sitting dog whittled from scrap wood by firelight, the way dogs used to wait by the door.  Someone made this for you.
